Date June 15, 19 38.
Subject Communication dated 4-6-38 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General concerning Messrs V.I. Cheoussoff and N.I. Romaniuk
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiew Forwarded by C. Gausla A S

1. Vassily Ivanovich CHEOUSSOFF, Russian, born on
January 12, 1886, at Ust-Sysolsk, vologda province,
Russia. According to his own statement, he arrived in
Harbin in October, 1918 from Irkutsk, Siberia, where he
was employed in the local opera company. Subsequently
he resided in Harbin where he worked in the same capacity
and also was employed in the Administration Office of the
Chinese Eastern Railway. He arrived in Shanghai from
Harbin in December, 1937. Here he has been without
fixed employment, casually working in his capacity of an
opera singer under his stage name Chehov in the local
Russian opera company etc.

Cheoussoff is a widower and has two sons, aged
18 and 15 years, respectively. He is registered with
the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road
on the strength of passport No.2567 issued at Harbin on
December 13, 1937. It appears, from the registration
form of the Committee, that in 1926-1932 he was a Soviet
citizen and that he renounced his Soviet citizenship
in 1933.

2. Nikolai Ivanovich ROMANIUK, Russian, born on
November 15, 1896 in Holm Province, South Russia. He
arrived in Shanghai in 1924 from Harbin where, according
to his own statement, he had resided for about ten years.
Here he has been employed for various periods with
different Russian church choirs, theatrical enterprises
etc. as a singer.

报告
日期：1938年6月15日。
事由：荷兰总领事馆于1938年4月6日来函，涉及 V.I. Cheoussoff 先生和 N.I. Romaniuk 先生
由特别支部督察 Prokofiew 呈报，经 C. Gausla A S 转递

1. 瓦西里·伊万诺维奇·切乌索夫（Vassily Ivanovich CHEOUSSOFF），俄国人，1886年1月12日出生于俄罗斯沃洛格达省（vologda province）的乌斯季瑟索尔斯克（Ust-Sysolsk）。据其自述，他于1918年10月从西伯利亚的伊尔库茨克抵达哈尔滨，当时他在当地的歌剧团任职。随后他居住在哈尔滨，从事同样的工作，并受雇于中东铁路局行政办公室。他于1937年12月从哈尔滨抵达上海。在此地他没有固定职业，以艺名“Chehov”在当地俄罗斯歌剧团等地临时担任歌剧演员。

切乌索夫是一名鳏夫，有两个儿子，年龄分别为18岁和15岁。他凭1937年12月13日在哈尔滨签发的第2567号护照，在莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。从该委员会的登记表来看，他在1926年至1932年间是苏联公民，并于1933年放弃了苏联国籍。

2. 尼古拉·伊万诺维奇·罗马纽克（Nikolai Ivanovich ROMANIUK），俄国人，1896年11月15日出生于俄罗斯南部的霍尔姆省（Holm Province）。他于1924年从哈尔滨抵达上海，据其自述，他在哈尔滨居住了约十年。在此地，他曾断续受雇于不同的俄罗斯教堂唱诗班、戏剧团体等，担任歌手。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1632.
SHANGHAI, 4th June 1938.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Messrs. Vassili
Ivanovitch Tcheoussoff and Nicolaes Ivanovitch Romanink have
applied to this Consulate General for a visé for admission
into the Netherlands.

Mr. Tcheoussoff is in possession of a Nansen passport
No.90 issued at Shanghai on April 14, 1938.

According to this certificate he is born at Vologda
on January 12, 1886 and he has been in possession of an
Identification card No.6998 issued by the local French
Police on April 13, 1938.

His residence at Shanghai is at 193 Tenant de la Tour.

Mr. Romanink is in possession of a Nansen passport
No.91, issued at Shanghai on April 14, 1938.

According to this certificate he is born at Brest
Litorsk on November 15, 1896 and he has been in possession
of an Identification card No.560, issued by the local French
Police on January 27, 1938.

His residence at Shanghai is at 40 Route Père Robert.

Both persons intend to join the Platoff Don Cossack
Choir under the direction of Michael Podoli, which Choir
is touring in the Netherlands Indies, British India and the
Malay States.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against these
persons from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 9 JUNE 1938 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Consul-General.

9/6 D.S.J. Podolius.
E 9/6

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第1632号。
上海，1938年6月4日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，瓦西里·伊万诺维奇·切乌索夫（Vassili Ivanovitch Tcheoussoff）和尼古拉斯·伊万诺维奇·罗马宁克（Nicolaes Ivanovitch Romanink）先生已向本总领事馆申请进入荷兰的签证。

切乌索夫先生持有1938年4月14日在上海签发的南森护照（Nansen passport）第90号。

根据该证件，他于1886年1月12日出生于沃洛格达（Vologda），并持有1938年4月13日由当地法国警察签发的第6998号身份证。

他在上海的住址为 Tenant de la Tour 路193号。

罗马宁克先生持有1938年4月14日在上海签发的南森护照第91号。

根据该证件，他于1896年11月15日出生于布列斯特-利托夫斯克（Brest Litorsk），并持有1938年1月27日由当地法国警察签发的第560号身份证。

他在上海的住址为 Père Robert 路40号。

两人均打算加入由迈克尔·波多利（Michael Podoli）指挥的普拉托夫顿河哥萨克合唱团（Platoff Don Cossack Choir），该合唱团正在荷属东印度、英属印度和马来亚邦联巡回演出。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握有关这些人的不利情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，

您的恭顺仆人，

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1938年6月9日 / 特别支部）

副警司
特别支部，上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

总领事。

9/6 D.S.J. Podolius.
E 9/6
